name: Susi
title: Father of the spy Gaddi from the tribe of Manasseh
summary: Susi was a man from the tribe of Manasseh and father to Gaddi, who was one of the twelve spies Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. Susi is mentioned only once in the Bible, in connection with the appointment of the spies. His significance lies in the fact that his son was chosen to represent the tribe of Manasseh in this important task.

keyEvents.title: Gaddi appointed as a spy
keyEvents.description: Susi is mentioned as the father of Gaddi, who was selected to represent the tribe of Manasseh among the twelve spies sent to explore the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The sending of the spies to Canaan
keyEvents.description: Moses sent twelve men, one from each tribe, including Gaddi son of Susi, to explore the promised land and bring back a report about the land and its people.

keyEvents.title: The return of the spies with a negative report
keyEvents.description: Ten of the twelve spies, including Gaddi son of Susi, returned with a negative report that caused fear among the Israelites and led the people to refuse to enter the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The people's rebellion and God's judgment
keyEvents.description: As a result of the negative report from the majority of the spies, including Gaddi, the people of Israel were sentenced to wander in the wilderness for forty years before they could enter the promised land.
